title: fix(lint, metadata-protocol)!: an object publish that makes a field readonly while a live flow of its package writes it is refused
body:
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DSSTCMHG96EByEM5ULvQjKY)_ Fixes #32666 Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — accept set narrowed at the runtime object write doors; the `@objectstack/lint` type surface grows by four optional fields reachable from the package entry: `ReferenceIntegrityRule.subjects`, `ReferenceIntegrityRunOptions.subjectPass`, `AuthoringRuleContext.subjectPass`, and `runRuntimeAuthoringRules`' `subjectObjects` argument. Metadata-protocol: narrowed Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-automation` and `skills/objectstack-data` already teach that a `runAs: 'user'` write to a `readonly` field is stripped and that a flow maintaining one runs `runAs: 'system'`; the refusal names the flow and node and carries that remedy. The limit that callout leaves out (a button starts an elevated flow only as a `screen` or `api` flow; an autolaunched one answers 403) is #32832, open in the skills lane. ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么**:发布对象时(批量发布和直接保存两扇门),平台会把同一软件包里已上线的流程一起拿来检查:如果这次把某个字段改成只读,而某个以用户身份运行的流程还在写这个字段,发布直接被拒(422),报错里写明是哪个流程、哪个节点。字段改成「条件只读」(readonlyWhen)则只给提示、照常发布。 - **为什么改**:卡上的现象是「先上线流程、后把字段锁成只读」,对象照常发布,之后员工点按钮显示成功却什么也没改。按裁决 A(6837273204),在改只读的那一刻就告诉管理员哪个流程会失效。 - **风险与回滚**:这是一次收窄(以前能发布的对象现在可能被拒);`@objectstack/lint` 对外类型多了四个可选字段(`subjects`、两处 `subjectPass`、`subjectObjects`),所以 Clause-② 记为 yes。只追究这次发布新造成的冲突,租户上原本就存在的冲突不算在这次头上;别的软件包的流程不检查。示例库实测 0 误报(34 个对象、45 个流程)。只有「只读字段/流程」这一项判断会看到这些流程,对象的其他发布检查与改动前完全一致(复审后收窄)。每次发布对象多一次元数据读取;批量发布里有对象草稿时,每个流程草稿多读一次(未在生产库上测耗时)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。 - **先看**:`packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.ts`(流程只进单独的「判断对象」一轮,普通一轮与 main 一致;流程写入时路径保持 `flows[0]`)、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts`(批量发布里被写对象的草稿只在那一轮里不当作「已存储版本」)、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-gate.ts`(只取本包流程)。 - **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol-publish-drafts-closure.test.ts -t "#32666"`,预期 13 条全部通过,其中「object made readonly after the flow went live is refused 422」两条覆盖两扇门,「confined: …」一条证明其他对象规则照旧。 - **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。 ## What changes The ruled letter A (ruling 6837273204): an OBJECT publish carries the written package's live flows into the same `flow-update-readonly-field` (and `-when`) judgment a flow publish runs, and refuses only the conflicts this write newly causes. - **`packages/lint` — the member.** `validateReadonlyFlowWrites` in the reference-integrity suite declares `runtimeTypes: ['flow', 'object']`, the way `validateObjectFieldRefs` already does, and `subjects: ['flows']` (new `ReferenceIntegrityRule.subjects`). The `object` member roster pin in `runtime-gate.object-writes.test.ts` names it as the seventh crossing. - **`packages/lint` — the subject pass (review round 1).** The gate withholds every judged-subject collection (`SUBJECT_ONLY_CONTEXT_KEYS`) from its ordinary differential, so every rule of the object door, `validatePresetComparands` and `validateStackExpressions` included, judges exactly the snapshot it judged on main. A separate SUBJECT differential (same baseline / stored / candidate passes) runs only the reference-integrity entry (`SUBJECT_PASS_ENTRIES`) with `subjectPass: true`, and the suite then runs only members declaring `subjects`. `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` gains `subjectObjects`: the objects that pass judges against when they differ from `context.objects`. - **`packages/lint` — the snapshot.** `RuntimeStackContext` gains `flows?` (judged subjects of an object write). The docblock's admission rule ("only collections a rule's resolution references enter the context") is reworded to admit judged subjects, and states the three properties that keep the admission narrow (condition 2 of the ruling). `CONTEXT_STACK_KEY_ORDER` gains `flows` last, so the four existing collections keep their order and the derived pattern source. - **`packages/lint` — flow writes stay positional.** New `SUBJECT_ONLY_CONTEXT_KEYS = {'flows'}`: on a `flow` write the gate drops any passed `flows` context, so the written flow is the sole member and `flows[0]` IS the write; `nameKeyFindingPath` takes the written stack key and keeps that index positional. On an object write, a finding on a carried flow is name-keyed (`flows.FLOW_NAME.nodes[1].config.fields.status`), since the index is the gate's private snapshot slot. - **`packages/metadata-protocol` — the host gather.** `judgeRuntimeAuthoringRules` reads `listCollection('flow', 'flows')` on an OBJECT write only, in the same `Promise.all` as the other four reads, and keeps the flows whose `_packageId` is the written package (`flowsOfWrittenPackage`; a package-less write meets package-less flows). Flows of other packages are out of scope. - **`packages/metadata-protocol` — the batch.** `CLOSURE_CONTEXT_KEY_BY_TYPE` gains `flow: 'flows'` and the `-?` pending literal gains `flows: []` (both forced by the compile-time completeness guards). `objectWriteFlowSubjects` subtracts the flows the batch redrafts from the live set: a redrafted flow is its own write's to answer for, and judging its stale live copy would refuse the one-batch way out. Pending flows are never added as subjects, so the existing "flow and object drafted in ONE batch" pin still names the flow as the causal item. - **`packages/metadata-protocol` — the stored universe of the subject pass.** On an object write that carries flows, the host hands the batch fold WITHOUT the written object's own draft as `subjectObjects`; `context.objects` keeps the full fold, exactly as on main. The batch folds the written draft into the context, so the gate's stored self (#22118) IS the candidate and a finding the write adds on another entry cancels against itself; that is still what every other object-door rule sees (a draft that breaks a live sibling under them publishes as on main, pinned). Only the subject pass judges against the written object's live body, the universe the live save door already judges against. Round 1 left the draft out for every rule, which widened refusals at publish-drafts; the review probe confirmed it (an object draft dropping a column a live lookup's `lookupColumns` names: refused `object-field-ref-unknown` at `495824e8`, published with main's gate files) and round 2 publishes it. - **`packages/metadata-protocol` — the flow-draft read.** `collectBatchPendingDeclarations` reads a flow draft only in a batch that also holds an object draft, the one case `pending.flows` is read (`objectWriteFlowSubjects`). A batch without an object draft pays no extra read. - **`packages/spec`** — ADR-0087 D3 semantic entry `object-readonly-field-written-by-live-flow-refused`. - Changeset: minor for `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/spec`, with the BREAKING banner and migration. ## Tests - `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.object-readonly-flow-writes.test.ts` (new, 9): the reverse order refuses with the name-keyed path; `readonlyWhen` gives the `-when` advisory and no refusal; the way out (flow already `runAs: 'system'`) is clean; a conflict already in the stored universe is not charged to a label edit; an object write handed no flows judges none; a flow write ignores a passed `flows` context and keeps `flows[0]`; the fence (an object write turning a field into a `date` while a carried flow filters on it with a preset name gets no `validatePresetComparands` finding); `subjectObjects` (the fold with the written draft cancels, the subject objects refuse); the suite on its subject pass runs only subject-declaring members. - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-publish-drafts-closure.test.ts` (9 new door pins): publish-drafts refuses the reverse order 422 `INVALID_METADATA`; the live save refuses it 422; `readonlyWhen` publishes with the `-when` advisory; the way out (flow elevated and published first, then the field made readonly) publishes clean; the way out in ONE batch publishes clean; a conflict already on the tenant (made through `OS_ALLOW_UNLINTED_METADATA_WRITES`) does not refuse a label edit; a flow of another package is out of scope; a flow redrafted UNFIXED in the same batch is the causal item, refused `INVALID_METADATA` with `flow-update-readonly-field` at `flows[0]…`; confinement: a master draft dropping a column a live detail's `lookupColumns` names publishes, as on main, with a live flow in the package. - Pins moved with the widened context set: `runtime-gate.test.ts`, `runtime-gate.derived-context-keys.test.ts`, `runtime-gate.derived-name-keys.test.ts`, `runtime-gate.object-writes.test.ts`. ## Acceptance notes - **False positives on the shipped corpus (condition 2): 0.** Every object in `examples/app-crm`, `app-multi-package` (both packages), `app-showcase`, `app-todo` and `packages/apps/connector-{docusign,github,stripe}` was written through `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` as an update and as a create, with and without its package's flows: 34 objects, 45 flows, 68 object writes, 0 findings added by the flows. Positive controls (lock the first field a `runAs: 'user'` `update_record` of that package writes): 4 of 4 refused. `packages/apps/account`, `setup` and `studio` have no `objectstack.config.ts` and declare no flows. - **Other object-dispatched rules that read `stack.flows`.** None sees the carried flows: they are withheld from the ordinary differential, and the subject pass runs only `validateReadonlyFlowWrites` (pinned, ablations F1 and F2). The census above was rerun on the round-2 head: same 0 added, 4 of 4 controls. - **Cost:** one more indexed `sys_metadata` read per object publish, issued with the four existing reads, plus a registry walk; on a package publish holding an object draft, one draft-row read per flow draft in the batch (none in a batch without an object draft); and, on an object write carrying a non-empty flow set, one more three-pass run of the one suite entry. Not measured on a production store. - **Limits (D3 entry states them):** flows of other packages are not judged; a package-less tenant overlay save meets only package-less flows, so locking a field of a packaged object through such an overlay is not judged against that package's flows. - **Out of scope, by the ruling:** hook and action bodies that write readonly fields, flows of other packages, tenants already in the broken state. Option C (the person who clicked is told) is #32861. ## Verification Round 2 on head `13c704fe` (review record 6839975695; main not merged again, no conflict). Round 3 (delta review 6841160520) changes only the changeset's declarations; the changeset and clause-② gate families and `check-adr-0087-registration` were rerun on its head (listed at the end of the gates block). - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: 8591 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: 22799 passed, 36 skipped. Both typechecks exit 0. - Full dogfood battery (`(narrowing)` arm) under the lock: VERDICT command-exit 0; 456 files passed / 3 skipped, 3831 tests passed / 42 skipped. - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 93 families derived (round 1's 92 plus `check:cli-command-ids`), all run, all exit 0. `--ran`: 93 derived, 93 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. - Corpus census rerun on the round-2 head: 34 objects, 45 flows, 68 object writes, 0 findings added; 4 of 4 positive controls refused.
Ablations (one per new behaviour, each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob) | # | Mutation | Result | |---|---|---| | A1 | member `runtimeTypes` back to `['flow']` | lint pins: refusal and `-when` advisory red (2 failed) | | A2 | flow-write drop of the `flows` context removed | lint pin: flow write path red (1 failed) | | A3 | name-key guard for a subject's own write removed | name-key pin red (1 failed) | | A4 | host gather off | door pins red (publish-drafts, live save, `-when`: 3 failed) | | A5 | package filter accepts every flow | other-package pin red (1 failed) | | A6 | redrafted-flow subtraction removed | one-batch way-out pin red (1 failed). First run was a no-op: the pin staged the flow first, so its promotion was already live when the object was judged; the pin now stages the object first and the rerun went red | | A7 | (round 1) written draft folded back into the object-write context | publish-drafts refusal and `-when` pins red (2 failed) | | C1 | (round 2) confinement removed: `context.objects` takes `subjectObjects` again, as round 1 did | confinement door pin red (1 failed) | | C2 | (round 2) host stops handing `subjectObjects` | publish-drafts refusal and `-when` pins red (2 failed) | | F1 | (round 2) fence removed: carried flows stay in the ordinary differential | refusal, `-when` (finding now doubled) and the `validatePresetComparands` fence pin red (3 failed) | | F2 | (round 2) suite member filter on the subject pass removed | subject-pass member pin red (1 failed). No shipped object-dispatched member other than `validateReadonlyFlowWrites` reads `flows` (probed), so this filter is the in-suite guard for the next one |
